goal: Prevent corrupted compressed scripts from silently becoming spendable empty scripts
Ensure decompression failures raise an explicit error rather than silently returning a blank script
agreement: Broad support for fixing silent decompression failures, but an objection remains unaddressed
Unaddressed objection: rollback snapshots skip unreadable coins and can succeed with missing coins (l0rinc)
Support because error handling aligns with existing decoding exceptions (purpleKarrot)
Verified by testing against thousands of test vectors and corrupted snapshots on regtest (fametrano)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because corrupted UTXO records can silently turn unspendable outputs into anyone-can-spend scripts
Prevents invalid or corrupted data from causing unintended spending behavior during validation
